statement: Read bg_reclaim_threshold under allocation/data or allocation/metadata to learn the percentage of a block group's reclaimable space, excluding permanently unusable space, at which the kernel reclaims that whole block group; the file is read-write since kernel 5.19.
quote: Reclaimable space percentage of block group

statement: The per-filesystem space accounting directory is /sys/fs/btrfs/<UUID>/allocation on kernel 7.2.11, holding global_rsv_reserved, global_rsv_size and the data, metadata and system subdirectories; the chapter's section spells the name allocations, its own layout table spells allocation.
quote: Files and directories in :file:`/sys/fs/btrfs/UUID/allocations` directory are:

statement: Read /sys/fs/btrfs/<UUID>/allocation/metadata/bytes_used for used metadata space and total_bytes beside it for metadata block groups' total size; both files are read-only and may change rapidly.
Read /sys/fs/btrfs/<UUID>/allocation/data/bytes_used for data space in use and total_bytes for the data block groups' total size; both are read-only and may change rapidly with load.

global_rsv_size in /sys/fs/btrfs/<UUID>/allocation is the total size in bytes of the global block reservation, read-only since kernel 3.14; global_rsv_reserved beside it gives the reservation's used bytes.
